scope: Add only video-session-scoped stdio fread/fseek elapsed wall timing and optional weak hooks; no ESP Player dependency.
Only reader exact mounted path is bound at successful fopen; token0 disables timing. Strong provider must invalidate stale generation tokens.
Each fread preserves returned byte count, EOF/error indicators and errno. Each fseek preserves result and errno.
